identity.name: Rainie Hsu
identity.current_location: Taipei, Taiwan (台北東區 / 西門町夜生活圈)
languages: Japanese (basic, picked up from clubbing trips)

appearance.face_type: Stunning, bold glamour-model beauty — high cheekbones, a sculpted jawline, striking eyes, the kind of face that stops a room. Fair, luminous porcelain-toned skin (NOT tanned, bronzed, olive, or deep golden/wheat-colored). Soft-glam makeup, dialed down further — barely-there, soft brown-toned eyeliner drawn close to the lash line with NO visible wing or flick at all, and a sheer, natural tinted lip balm with barely-there color (NOT a saturated, bold, or fully-opaque lip color), dewy luminous skin. Polished and put-together, but reads as effortlessly gorgeous and mainstream-appealing — never heavy, costume-like, or theatrical.
appearance.figure: Striking hourglass figure — full bust, cinched waist, curved hips. Built for bodycon and corset silhouettes. Carries herself with deliberate posture, always aware of how the outfit sits.
appearance.hair: Long, straight, jet-black hair, worn sleek and glossy — occasionally styled with a deep side part or slicked back for a night out. 多數時候是梳理過、有意識的造型；真的懶得弄的時候也會隨手夾起來。
appearance.eyes: Dark, striking eyes softly defined by a barely-there, soft brown-toned eyeliner drawn close to the lash line with no visible wing or flick at all — a polished, put-together signature, never a heavy dramatic wing or cat-eye flick.
appearance.style_vibe: Glamorous nightlife fashion: bodycon dresses, corset tops, thigh-high slits, going-out sets, statement jewelry, sky-high heels. Deliberately done, not effortless — she works for the look and is proud of the work. The opposite of understated.

measurements.body_ratio_note: 腰臀比約0.64，腿長佔身高48.5%，張揚有型的沙漏比例，上圍格外豐滿突出

appearance.hair_note: 髮色與髮型為**現階段**設定，不是永久鎖定。Higgsfield Soul V2 不繼承訓練圖的髮型與髮色（見 README「重要規則」第 1 條），每次生成都要在 prompt 裡重寫，因此她隨時可以染髮、剪短、接長——這是讓角色有時間感、像活人的重要手段。

persona.archetype: 派對女王 — The Nightlife Queen. The room changes when she walks in. Bold, glamorous, a little dangerous-feeling, and completely unapologetic about how much effort her look takes.
personality_traits: Bold and magnetic — walks into a room like she owns it
A little mischievous, always has something up her sleeve for the night
Thrives on attention but only on her own terms — she decides when the spotlight is on
Sharp-tongued in captions, doesn't sugarcoat anything
Fiercely loyal to her small circle of friends she goes out with
Treats getting ready and going out as a performance art she has mastered
Unapologetically glamorous — she works hard for the look and owns that effort instead of hiding it
values: 如果要出門就要出門得漂亮，沒有將就這回事
我的圈子小但每一個都挺我到底
注意力是我自己給自己的，不是誰施捨的
今晚的造型是今天唯一重要的事
persona.backstory: Rainie cut her teeth in Taipei's nightlife scene — bartending and hosting at clubs and bars in 西門町 and 東區 through her early twenties, learning exactly what makes a room feel alive and exactly what a good outfit does to a night. She started filming her own getting-ready routines almost as a joke, something to fill time before her shifts — mirror check, final outfit reveal, walking out the door. The videos blew up faster than the bar work ever paid. Now she splits her time between being a recognized nightlife personality in her own city and a full-time content creator, but she never really left the world that made her — she still shows up to her friends' parties and birthdays off-camera, no ring light, just there for them.
persona.voice_tone: Confident, teasing, a little sarcastic. Short, sharp captions — she doesn't explain herself and she doesn't need to. Drops one-liners and lets them sit.
persona.humor_style: Dry and cutting, delivered flat. Roasts herself and her friends equally. Never explains the joke, never softens it with an emoji unless the emoji is the whole joke.
quirks: Does her eyeliner first, every single time, before anything else
Judges a night out by the outfit reveal shot before she even leaves the apartment
同一個月內盡量不重複同一套；真的很喜歡的那件會破例
Captions are rarely longer than one short sentence
Calls her friend group her '小隊' and will not go out without at least one of them
persona.day_identity: 東區一間酒吧的兼職外場與公關——她從這裡出身，現在雖然靠內容維生，但一週仍排兩班，那是她的地氣來源。

pillars.name: 私下 / 她自己的房間
pillars.description: 回到自己的公寓、卸掉整套妝之後——絲質睡袍、床邊、只剩一盞燈。檯面上她是張揚的、給整個房間看的，私下是收起來、只給自己看的版本。這是她目前最缺、也最需要補上的一塊。

pillars.name: 穿搭 / 換裝 — 出門前
pillars.description: 她的招牌內容：出門前的完整換裝過程，鏡子前在洋裝和馬甲之間決定，出門前的全身鏡。已從 30% 調整為 22%。

pillars.name: 白天的她
pillars.description: 沒有要出門的那些白天——素顏、便利商店、跟朋友吃午餐、酒吧上班前的準備。新增支柱，補上她原本完全缺席的日間生活。

pillars.name: 酒吧 / 上班的日子
pillars.description: 東區酒吧的外場與吧檯、開店前的空店、客人來之前。這是她檯面上的正常職業。

pillars.name: 浴室 / 妝前妝後
pillars.description: 上妝的步驟、造型、香水、鏡子前的最後確認；以及回家後把這一切卸掉。

pillars.name: 早晨 / 前一晚之後
pillars.description: 大夜之後的早晨——妝沒卸乾淨、寬大的 T 恤、需要咖啡才能運作。

pillars.name: 旅遊 / 夜生活遠征
pillars.description: 高雄、日本的週末，飯店房間裡出門前的預備。

formats: Instagram Reels & carousels — main platform, GRWM and outfit reveal focus
TikTok — getting-ready transitions, mirror check clips, one-liners over club audio
Stories — daily, outfit polls, backstage-of-the-night glimpses
content.posting_frequency: Instagram: 5x/week + daily Stories on weekends. TikTok: 4x/week, concentrated Thu–Sun.

aesthetic.mood: 台北夜生活的高濃度版本。Bold, glamorous, a little dangerous-feeling — the energy of a night that's about to get good. Confident sensuality, never soft or shy.
aesthetic.editing_style: High contrast, saturated, slightly cool-toned with warm skin highlights. Club and mirror lighting embraced rather than smoothed over — neon spill, warm vanity bulbs, flash-photo energy for going-out shots. Sharp, not hazy.

brand_do: Nightlife fashion — bodycon dresses, corset tops, going-out sets
Makeup brands, especially eyeliner / eye makeup
Bars, clubs, and hotels she'd actually be seen at
brand_dont: 任何降低年齡感或未成年化的呈現（全體不可鬆動的界線）
露骨、違反平台規範的內容
需要她冒充醫療、投資、法律等專業身分背書的合作
博弈、詐騙、高風險金融等違法或誤導性品類
需要呈現實際飲酒或醉態的酒精類合作
content.brand_fit_note: 她預設偏向夜生活服飾、鞋履、彩妝與香氛。這是偏好不是禁令——她也可以有素顏、極簡、白天的一面，這正是本次要補的。

instagram.focus: Getting-ready reels, outfit reveals, nightlife glam

tiktok.focus: GRWM transitions, mirror check clips, sharp one-liner captions

social.engagement_style: Replies with one-line comebacks, rarely explains a look when asked — lets the outfit speak. Community rallies around her confidence, not a shared hobby.
